meta.description: InsightX P0 演示数据集：人工编写的合成 Amazon 评论样本，用于无凭证环境下的端到端演示与测试。全部文本为自编通用表述，未经任何真实来源采集，不代表真实商品口碑。

product.title: ErgoPro High-Back Mesh Ergonomic Office Chair with 3D Armrests & Lumbar Support

reviews.title: Armrest snapped off
reviews.body: The left armrest snapped right at the height adjustment bracket after barely three weeks of normal use. Plastic is far too thin for daily leaning.

reviews.title: Broken armrest
reviews.body: Armrest cracked where it joins the seat. It just snapped during a normal workday. Clearly a weak point in the molding.

reviews.title: Armrest wobbles
reviews.body: The right armrest is loose and wobbles constantly. Screw holes seem misaligned. I tightened everything twice.

reviews.title: Cracked after one month
reviews.body: Both armrests cracked at the same spot near the adjustment button. Poor plastic quality, dangerous sharp edges now.

reviews.title: Armrest padding peels
reviews.body: The armrest pad surface started peeling after two months. Underneath the plastic is rough and scratched my elbow.

reviews.title: Adjustment lever broke
reviews.body: The height adjustment lever broke on day 40. The armrest bracket also shows hairline cracks. Requesting a refund.

reviews.title: Armrest sheared off completely
reviews.body: The whole armrest assembly sheared off when I pushed myself up from the desk. The plastic stem is broken inside the socket.

reviews.title: Crack developing on armrest
reviews.body: A visible crack is developing along the inner armrest rib. I weight 70kg and use the chair gently, so this is a material weakness.

reviews.title: Sharp plastic edge on armrest
reviews.body: The armrest has a sharp flashing edge from the mold that scratched my forearm. Quality control clearly missed this one.

reviews.title: Armrest bolts keep loosening
reviews.body: The armrest bolts keep loosening every two weeks. I added thread locker myself. Design should include lock washers.

reviews.title: Armrest snapped within a week
reviews.body: Left armrest snapped within a week of light use. The break looks brittle, like old or recycled plastic was used.

reviews.title: Armrest creaks under load
reviews.body: Armrest creaks and flexes under any real load. Feels like it will fail soon. Expected better at this price.

reviews.title: Broken armrest, refund requested
reviews.body: Armrest broke clean off the mount. Customer service offered a replacement bracket only. I want a refund for a dangerous chair.

reviews.title: Hairline crack on right armrest
reviews.body: Found a hairline crack on the right armrest base this morning. Chair is otherwise fine, but this part will not survive the year.

reviews.title: Lumbar support slides down
reviews.body: The lumbar support slides all the way down whenever I lean back. The friction clip cannot hold any real weight.

reviews.title: Lumbar pad keeps dropping
reviews.body: Lumbar pad keeps dropping to the bottom of the rail no matter how hard I tighten the knob. Useless lower back support now.

reviews.title: Lumbar knob stripped
reviews.body: The lumbar adjustment knob stripped after a month, so the support just slides. Otherwise the chair is okay for the price.

reviews.title: Back support rail too loose
reviews.body: The back support rail is too loose and the lumbar cushion sinks under any pressure. Needs a real locking mechanism.

reviews.title: Lumbar slide has no detents
reviews.body: The lumbar slide has no detents, so it creeps down an inch every hour. I keep nudging it back up all day.

reviews.title: Support cushion falls
reviews.body: The lower back support cushion falls down the rails by itself. Plastic-on-plastic friction is simply not enough.

reviews.title: Casters squeak loudly
reviews.body: The casters squeak loudly on hardwood after two weeks. Also they leave black scuff marks that are hard to remove.

reviews.title: Wheels ruined my floor
reviews.body: These cheap wheels ruined my hardwood floor with black streaks. The PU coating is wearing through already.

reviews.title: One wheel squeaks
reviews.body: One of the wheels squeaks on every rotation and another sticks on carpet fibers. I may just replace all five casters.

reviews.title: Caster stem fits poorly
reviews.body: A caster stem fits poorly in the base socket and the wheel wobbles. Feels like tolerance is off on the star base.

reviews.title: Squeaky wheels out of the box
reviews.body: Squeaky wheels right out of the box. Rolling is noisy on tiles. Everything else about the chair is acceptable.

reviews.title: Box arrived destroyed
reviews.body: The box arrived crushed at one corner and the gas lift cylinder had punched through the carton. Parts were falling out on my porch.

reviews.title: Packaging too flimsy
reviews.body: Packaging is too flimsy for a chair this heavy. The carton was torn and the styrofoam was shattered into pieces.

reviews.title: Damaged in transit
reviews.body: Damaged in transit because there is basically no padding inside. The mesh seat frame was bent and dented.

reviews.title: Crushed corner, dented parts
reviews.body: Box corner was crushed and the armrest housing arrived dented. Amazon replaced it, but the second box also arrived soft at the edges.

reviews.title: Box wet and soft
reviews.body: The carton arrived wet and soft with no plastic wrap. luckily the parts were fine, but the packaging needs a moisture barrier.

reviews.title: Cylinder punched through box
reviews.body: The heavy gas cylinder punched right through the box during shipping. Sharp metal edge exposed. This is a packaging design failure.

reviews.title: Styrofoam everywhere
reviews.body: Cheap styrofoam crumbled everywhere inside the box. No cardboard retaining sheet, no bubble wrap around the metal parts.

reviews.title: Instructions very confusing
reviews.body: The assembly instructions are very confusing. Steps are out of order and the diagrams do not show which screw goes where.

reviews.title: Wrong manual page
reviews.body: My manual was missing page two entirely. I had to guess the base assembly sequence from a video online.

reviews.title: Took two hours to assemble
reviews.body: Assembly took me two hours because the instructions show tiny unlabeled diagrams. The M6 and M8 screws look identical in the pictures.

reviews.title: Screws mixed up
reviews.body: I mixed up the long and short screws because the manual does not label them clearly, and I stripped a thread hole. Better labeling please.

reviews.title: Strong chemical smell
reviews.body: Strong chemical smell straight out of the box. Had to leave it on the balcony for four days before the odor faded.

reviews.title: Unbearable odor
reviews.body: The odor from the foam is unbearable in a small room. My eyes water after an hour. It has been a week and the smell lingers.

reviews.title: Smells like solvent
reviews.body: It smells like solvent for the first few days. Airing helped, but the packaging should mention this or use better foam.

reviews.title: Missing screws
reviews.body: The hardware bag was missing four M6 screws and two washers. Support sent replacements but that took another week.

reviews.title: Missing parts in box
reviews.body: Missing parts in the box: no allen key and only three of five caster wheels. Quality packing list check clearly failed.

reviews.title: No assembly tool included
reviews.body: No assembly tool included even though the manual references it. I had to buy an allen key set just to finish.

reviews.title: Seat too small for me
reviews.body: The seat is too small for a tall person. I am 6'2 and my thighs hang off the front edge. Check the dimensions before buying.

reviews.title: Narrow seat cushion
reviews.body: The seat cushion is narrow and firm. After one hour the sides of my legs press into the bolsters. Not for bigger users.

reviews.title: Base leg cracked
reviews.body: One leg of the five-star base cracked through after a month. The chair now tilts dangerously to one side.

reviews.title: Gas lift failed
reviews.body: The gas lift failed and the chair slowly sinks no matter the setting. Classic cheap cylinder. Refund requested.

reviews.title: Chair sinks by itself
reviews.body: The chair sinks by itself within minutes of adjusting the height. The cylinder seal seems defective.

reviews.title: Great chair for the price
reviews.body: Great chair for the price. Assembly was straightforward, mesh breathes well and the armrests adjust smoothly. Back pain improved after a week.

reviews.title: Solid budget ergonomic chair
reviews.body: Solid budget ergonomic chair. The lumbar support actually helps my posture. Docking one star because the tilt is a bit stiff.

reviews.title: Perfect for WFH
reviews.body: Perfect for working from home. Easy to assemble in about 30 minutes, very comfortable for long days and looks premium.

reviews.title: Comfortable and sturdy
reviews.body: Comfortable and sturdy so far. The headrest is a nice touch. I would prefer metal armrest mounts but no issues yet.

reviews.title: Best chair under 200
reviews.body: Easily the best chair under 200 dollars that I have owned. Reclining lock works well and the cushion keeps its shape.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.body: Good value overall. Mesh back keeps me cool. Only complaint is that the casters could roll more smoothly on carpet.

reviews.title: Very happy with this purchase
reviews.body: Very happy with this purchase. Delivery was fast, packaging was intact and everything fit together perfectly.

reviews.title: Nice upgrade
reviews.body: Nice upgrade from my old chair. The adjustable armrests and lumbar support make long coding sessions much easier on my back.

reviews.title: Excellent build quality
reviews.body: Excellent build quality for the money. No squeaks, no wobble, and the mesh has not sagged at all after two months.

reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Would buy again. The 3D armrests are genuinely useful and the backrest supports my shoulders. Assembly took 40 minutes.

reviews.title: Se perdió un tornillo
reviews.body: Faltaba un tornillo en la bolsa de herrajes y el respaldo se siente suelto. El soporte lumbar se desliza hacia abajo solo.

reviews.title: Se rompió el apoyabrazos
reviews.body: El apoyabrazos se rompió a las tres semanas de uso normal. El plástico es de muy mala calidad.

reviews.title: Huele a químico
reviews.body: La silla huele mucho a químico los primeros días. Tuvimos que ventilarla una semana entera antes de usarla.

reviews.title: Armlehne gebrochen
reviews.body: Die Armlehne ist nach vier Wochen gebrochen. Das Plastik ist einfach zu dünn an der Steuerung.

reviews.title: Verständnislose Anleitung
reviews.body: Die Anleitung ist sehr unklar, die Abbildungen sind winzig. Der Stuhl wackelt zudem leicht nach der Montage.

reviews.title: Armrest cracked at work
reviews.body: My armrest cracked loudly during a meeting. Now there is a jagged plastic edge and the pad sags. Two months old only.

reviews.title: Lumbar bar digs in
reviews.body: The lumbar bar digs into my back when the cushion slides low. The sliding rail tension is inconsistent across positions.

reviews.title: Wheel fell off
reviews.body: A wheel fell off its stem while rolling over a cable. Snapped back on but it keeps coming loose. Caster quality is poor.

reviews.title: Carton was opened
reviews.body: The carton arrived already opened and retaped, with scratched parts inside. Clearly returned goods or bad handling. Packaging needs seals.

reviews.title: Manual only in pictures
reviews.body: The manual only has pictures, no text at all. Torque values and part names are absent. Confusing for first-time assembly.

reviews.title: Foam smell in small office
reviews.body: Foam smell filled my small office on day one. Two weeks later there is still a faint odor when the sun heats the chair.

reviews.title: Screw holes misaligned
reviews.body: Two screw holes on the backrest were misaligned by a couple millimeters. Forced the bolts in and the plastic creaks now.

reviews.title: Armrest mount fractured
reviews.body: The armrest mount fractured diagonally right through the screw boss. This is a stress concentration problem, not user abuse.

reviews.title: Headrest wobbles
reviews.body: The headrest wobbles on its post no matter how much I tighten it. Also the whole chair feels slightly unstable at full height.

reviews.title: Delivery box left in rain
reviews.body: The delivery box was left in the rain, corners soggy. Inner bags saved the parts but a waterproof outer layer is basic.

reviews.title: Second unit, same armrest failure
reviews.body: Second unit with the same armrest failure. Both cracked at the left mount within two months. This is clearly a batch defect.

reviews.title: Lumbar support useless
reviews.body: Lumbar support is useless because it never stays where you set it. Design needs a positive lock, not friction alone.

reviews.title: Squeaky after a month
reviews.body: Chair developed squeaky pivot points after a month. A drop of oil fixed it but that should not be the buyer's job.

reviews.title: Inner box had no cushion
reviews.body: Inner box had no cushioning at all, just parts loose in a carton. The base arrived with chipped paint and a scratched cylinder.

reviews.title: Diagram steps confusing
reviews.body: The numbered bag idea is good but the diagram steps are still confusing about which side of the base faces forward.

reviews.title: Smell gave me a headache
reviews.body: The chemical smell gave me a headache within an hour of unboxing. Returned the chair because of it.

reviews.title: Short screws missing
reviews.body: Short screws for the armrest pads were missing from bag B. Hardware store run solved it but come on.

reviews.title: Too small for shared desk
reviews.body: Too small for a shared desk setup. My husband and I both find the backrest narrow and the seat short.

reviews.title: Good chair, minor gripes
reviews.body: Good chair with minor gripes: assembly took a while and the armrests feel hollow. Back support itself is genuinely good.

reviews.title: Comfortable for long hours
reviews.body: Comfortable for long programming hours. The mesh does not dig in and the adjustable lumbar hits the right spot for me.

reviews.title: Decent chair
reviews.body: Decent chair, sturdy base and smooth casters on tile. No regrets, though the instructions could be clearer.

reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.body: Exceeded expectations. Zero squeaks, solid lift, and the packaging arrived perfect with double-wall carton.

reviews.title: Happy overall
reviews.body: Happy overall. Mesh is cool in summer, assembly was fine with the video. Would like a slightly wider seat next time.

reviews.title: Snapped armrest and cracked base
reviews.body: The armrest snapped and the star base cracked in the same week. Both are load-bearing plastic parts. Do not buy if you weigh over 80kg.

reviews.title: Lumbar knob spins freely
reviews.body: The lumbar knob spins freely now and the support drifts down within minutes. Warranty claim in progress.

reviews.title: Scuff marks on tiles
reviews.body: Black scuff marks on my white tiles after a week. Wheels roll fine otherwise but the compound is too soft.

reviews.title: Box crushed by courier
reviews.body: Box crushed by the courier, corner split open, gas lift poking out through a hole. Immediate replacement needed.

reviews.title: Confusing step four
reviews.body: Step four of the manual is confusing, the diagram shows the washers on the wrong side. I assembled the armrests backwards first.

reviews.title: Plastic odor in hot room
reviews.body: Plastic odor gets stronger in a hot room. My guess is the foam adhesive. Ventilation helps but it should not be this strong.

reviews.title: Missing caster wheel
reviews.body: Missing one caster wheel entirely and the box had a hole. Support is sending a wheel, taking two weeks.

reviews.title: Broken within 30 days
reviews.body: Broken within 30 days: left armrest cracked clean through. Refund window closed right before it failed. Terrible luck or bad design.

reviews.title: Wobbly armrests
reviews.body: Both armrests wobble even with bolts torqued properly. The plastic threads in the seat shell strip easily.
